name: DOOM
tips: The game's Vulkan renderer is the one tested (DOOMx64vk.exe).

issues: Loading a scene could grow its memory footprint to about 30 GB, until Hadron's memory watchdog stopped it (the driver's depth-bounds emulation kept a depth snapshot for every depth-writing draw).
reports.notes: The startup blockers are fixed in 0.3.2: the game creates its Vulkan device and gets past the earlier descriptor assertion without any workaround.
reports.followUp: The depth-bounds fix (Hadron #158) shipped in 0.3.3 and issue #128 is closed; a report from 0.3.3 is wanted.

reports.notes: Without local workarounds the game refuses to create its Vulkan device: it asks for depth bounds, which the driver didn't offer then. It played with an experimental wrapper that reported the missing features, which isn't a fix.
